import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M, f):
        M = np.asarray(M, dtype=np.float64)
        k = M.shape[1]
        assert M.shape == (k, k)
        self.ret = f(M)
